Notes
-----
Proposals 13 and 15 have no <id>.dao.wei name, so dao.wei.limo renders their
description cell empty. Proposal 14 is named and needs nothing. The text is in
each ProposalCreated log, and the descriptions in these payloads are copied byte
for byte from those logs.

Cause: the naming in propose() runs inside a swallowed try/catch and ran out of gas.
#13 sent a 476,430 gas limit and used 471,322. #15 (a 1,992-byte description) sent
1,842,641 and used 1,815,920. In both, only the ProposalCreated log was emitted.

The batched payload is the DAO's multicall([rescue(DAO, 0, nameProposal(13, ...)),
rescue(DAO, 0, nameProposal(15, ...))]). multicall delegatecalls the DAO, so the
sender is still the exec.dao.wei holder (0x006CD14F36F65eCbB29b2519cCBe63A0DC8549F2),
which rescue requires. nameProposal only accepts calls from the DAO itself.

Rehearsed on a mainnet fork at block 26457095, sent from the exec holder: status 1,
2,124,644 gas used (estimate 2,157,803; give it about 2.4M). Both names mint to the
DAO with their description, target and value records, and html() renders both. The
proposals themselves are untouched: #13 stays vetoed and #15 stays open.
